scope.status: bounded dictionary-cell review, not complete §14.7 certification

table_locators.title: Entries in the structure tree root
Entries in a structure element dictionary

cells.rule: Catalog /StructTreeRoot locates the structure-tree-root dictionary; root /Type is required and shall be /StructTreeRoot.
cells.assessment: Root lookup/children are tested. Producer Type requirement does not itself require reader rejection.

cells.rule: Root /K is optional and, if present, is a structure-element dictionary or array of such dictionaries. Element /K can hold nested elements, MCID integers, MCR or OBJR dictionaries; a /K dictionary without /Type is assumed a structure element.
cells.assertions: Parent read both named tests: the_structure_tree_reads_its_children_and_maps_their_roles and a_mapped_role_reads_as_its_standard_type explicitly include /Type /StructElem. The draft claim that the latter omitted Type was false. New T163 provides a valid public Type-omission witness.
cells.assessment: Source fallback is implemented and a model test touches it, but lacks a producer-valid public-consumer witness; see draft.

cells.rule: IDTree is required if any elements have IDs and maps unique element identifiers to elements.
cells.assertions: viewer-core/tests/structure_identifiers_audit.rs::structure_id_uses_first_content_in_nested_hierarchy_order; logical_structure_example ID assertions; merge collision/preservation tests
cells.assessment: Lookup and navigation are asserted. Duplicate IDs are a producer rule; no reader rejection inferred.

cells.rule: Required where elements contain content items; number tree keys map page/object StructParent(s) keys to a parent element or MCID-indexed parent array.
cells.code: pdf-model/src/structure.rs ParentTree; owners/content and transform writer
cells.assertions: structure/tests::a_marked_content_identifier_finds_its_element; a_page_finds_its_elements_through_the_structural_parent_tree; tests/structure.rs page-key/corpus assertion; logical_structure_example and merge/archive tests
cells.assessment: Page, annotation/form/object and MCID-index routes are represented. Effective post-EC3 subsection number is §14.7.5.5; ledger note still cites 2020 §14.7.5.4.

cells.rule: Optional integer greater than existing keys, used as next key when adding to ParentTree.
cells.assessment: Writer field; no viewer display or accessibility output expected.

cells.rule: S is required structure type; root RoleMap maps document-specific names to approximate standard types under §§14.7.3/14.8.6.2.
cells.code: pdf-model/src/structure/roles.rs; viewer-core accessibility; viewer-accessibility platform-role map
cells.assertions: structure tests transitive maps/cycles; headless mapped role consumer; logical_structure_example
cells.assessment: Transitive mapping, cycles, and public role conversion have expected-value assertions; not every vocabulary or malformed map.

cells.rule: ClassMap maps class names to attribute object(s); /A and /C attach attributes/classes; when both define one attribute, /A wins; class and A arrays may carry revision numbers.
cells.assertions: structure tests later class precedence, owner/class/ancestry precedence, revision pairing; logical_structure_example class-vs-element; structure_attribute_stream_audit
cells.assessment: Distinct values and precedence are tested. EC3 #308 array null rules and #289 precedence are covered in adjacent shards; malformed null values are not reader-rejection duties.

cells.rule: Root Namespaces is required when elements use namespace IDs; element /NS is an indirect namespace dictionary, absent means default namespace. EC3 #396 requires referenced namespaces also be root-listed.
cells.code: roles.rs namespace resolution; transform namespace wrapper
cells.assertions: namespace map ownership, transitive target, foreign homonym and default controls; transform wrapper/merge
cells.assessment: Reader resolution/writer list management are tested. Producer list completeness does not require reader rejection or hiding.

cells.rule: P is required indirect immediate parent. Pg is required and indirect if K uses integer MCIDs.
cells.assertions: valid hierarchy/ParentTree fixtures include these references; logical_structure_example
cells.assessment: Representative valid paths covered; draft uses valid required parent references.

cells.rule: Optional title, scoped language, alternate description, expanded form and exact text replacement, owned by §14.9.
cells.code: structure metadata, marked text and accessibility code
cells.assertions: structure phrase language, Alt/E public accessibility tests, actual-text tests and prior metadata shards
cells.assessment: Selected public behaviors have assertions; optional fields do not require every node to be named/spoken.

cells.rule: Optional related elements and optional nonnegative revision number default 0; EC3 #93 marks R deprecated in PDF2.
cells.code: No current viewer consumer found for Ref/R in prior logical structure inventory.
cells.assessment: No required UI behavior inferred for optional unconsumed metadata; A/C attribute revisions are distinct and tested.

cells.rule: Optional pronunciation hints; §14.9.6 explicitly says processors are not required to process pronunciation hints.
cells.code: No pronunciation engine path; other text/language remains available.
cells.assertions: Prior phoneme test asserts Alt/Lang instead.

cells.rule: Optional associated file arrays for whole tree or one element; §14.13 owns handling.
cells.assessment: Not re-audited for extraction/UI; optional metadata does not demand a label.

verified_caret_text: Values or array elements shall not be null.
This array may contain elements that are null.
The array shall not contain elements that are null.
Attribute objects and revisions shall not be null.
Attribute class names and revisions shall not be null.
errata.disposition: Table-specific null semantics: the ParentTree reference array may contain null placeholders; the root/element child and A/C attribute arrays have null prohibitions. Do not convert into blanket null prohibition or required reader rejection.

that shall also be an element in the structure tree root Namespaces array
errata.disposition: Clarifies namespace-list completeness and relationship. The reader resolves element NS; producer completeness is not itself a rejection command.
Marks Table355 /R deprecated in PDF2.0; existing inventory says current viewer does not consume it.
Class-array precedence is handled in structure_attributes_remaining_current; not duplicated.
Renumbers structure content subclauses; dictionary cell semantics remain.
